usage: The word 薩摩亞 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Samoa.
薩摩亞 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about the country or its culture.
You can use 薩摩亞 in travel conversations to say where you want to go or have been.
薩摩亞 does not change form for singular or plural; it is always 薩摩亞.
When saying nationality or related adjectives, 薩摩亞人 means Samoan people.
